parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Use the definition of power to determine its SI base units.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
A light meter is used to measure the intensity of light in a classroom. Daylight is incident normally on the sensor of the meter. The sensor has an area of $2.2\text{ cm}^2$. The reading on the meter is $950\text{ W m}^{-2}$.

Calculate the power of the daylight incident on the sensor.
